title: Dec-BFTRL: Squre-Root Regret for Decentralized Online Upper-Linearizable Optimization under Separation Access with Application to Continuous Submodular Maximization
abstract: arXiv:2608.30271v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study decentralized online optimization of upper-linearizable payoffs over an action set under efficient separation access, with applications to online continuous diminishing-return (DR) submodular maximization. We propose Decentralized Barrier Follow-the-Regularized-Leader (Dec-BFTRL), and evaluate each agent's played action against the average of all local objectives. Each agent maps an internal iterate to a feasible action through an approximate gauge projection, communicates only a cumulative surrogate-gradient dual state, and invokes the local HybridNewton procedure to approximately minimize its post-communication BFTRL potential. For every agent, we achieve expected network-aggregate regret of $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$. Over $T$ rounds, each agent uses $T$ neighbor-mixing steps and $\widetilde O(T)$ separation-oracle calls. We give four wrapper instantiations covering three DR-submodular maximization problems.

translated_title: Dec-BFTRL：分离访问下去中心化在线上可线性化优化的平方根遗憾及其在连续次模最大化中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究在高效分离访问条件下，动作集上可上线性化收益的去中心化在线优化问题，其应用涵盖在线连续收益递减（DR）次模最大化。我们提出去中心化障碍正则化跟随领导者算法（Dec-BFTRL），并将每个智能体所执行的动作与所有局部目标的平均值进行对比评估。每个智能体通过近似规范投影将内部迭代点映射为可行动作，仅通信累积的代理梯度对偶状态，并调用本地 HybridNewton 过程来近似最小化通信后的 BFTRL 势函数。对于每个智能体，我们实现了期望网络聚合遗憾为 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$。在 $T$ 轮过程中，每个智能体仅需 $T$ 步邻居混合和 $\widetilde O(T)$ 次分离预言机调用。我们给出了四个包装器实例化，覆盖三个 DR 次模最大化问题。
tldr: 提出去中心化障碍正则化跟随领导者算法 Dec-BFTRL，在分离访问条件下对去中心化在线上可线性化优化实现了 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 的平方根遗憾界，并应用于连续 DR 次模最大化问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Dec-BFTRL, a decentralized barrier follow-the-regularized-leader algorithm achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ square-root regret for decentralized online upper-linearizable optimization under separation access, with applications to continuous DR-submodular maximization.
